title: Reports
subtitle: Oldest reports first. The list refreshes every 30 seconds.

table.caption: Reports, oldest first. Use the arrow keys to move and Enter to open the details.

detail.label: Report details
detail.placeholder: Pick a report in the list to see its details.
detail.related_one: Other report on the same target ({{count}})
detail.related_other: Other reports on the same target ({{count}})

evidence.notForTarget: Stream and channel reports carry no chat messages.
evidence.unavailableBody: The chat service did not answer when the report was filed.

resolve.title: Resolve report
resolve.body: Target: {{target}}. Pick an action, then write the conclusion; the reporter is told it was handled.
resolve.applyToSameTarget_one: Also close {{count}} other report on the same target
resolve.applyToSameTarget_other: Also close {{count}} other reports on the same target

choiceHint.NONE: Only close the report as a violation.
choiceHint.DELETE_MESSAGE: The message is hidden from everyone in the room.
choiceHint.TIMEOUT: They cannot send messages in this channel for a while.
choiceHint.BAN: They cannot chat in this channel until unbanned.
choiceHint.LOCK_USER: Signed out everywhere and disconnected from chat.
choiceHint.SUSPEND_CHANNEL: Ends the broadcast, chat read-only, channel hidden; no end date.
choiceHint.TAKEDOWN_STREAM: Ends the broadcast and deletes the replay.

dismiss.title: Dismiss report?
dismiss.body: The reporter will be told that no violation was found.

errors.alreadyClosed: The report has already been handled
errors.actionAppliedNotClosed: The action was applied but the report could not be closed: {{error}}
